acceptanceCriteria.command: legion gh -- api repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/contents/README.md --jq '.content' | base64 -d  (assert the exact marker line is present); pre-merge on the branch: cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" diff --from main@origin --to @ README.md (assert exactly one added line, that marker).
acceptanceCriteria.criterion: README.md at the repo root gains exactly one new line reading 'Stage 3 durable workflow proof for issue S390753994-1.'
acceptanceCriteria.skill: legion-worker (drives the implementer's push/PR and the tester's re-verification of the file surface).
acceptanceCriteria.surface: The README.md file on the merged main branch of sjawhar/legion-smoke (production-like surface: the real merged repository state).

acceptanceCriteria.command: legion gh -- pr view <n> --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke --json state,files,mergedAt  (assert state MERGED, files == [README.md]); CI: legion gh -- pr checks <n> --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke (assert ci/check and fail-on-demand/gate success at head SHA).
acceptanceCriteria.criterion: A PR carrying only that one-line change is opened, reviewed, and merged.
acceptanceCriteria.skill: legion-worker (implementer opens the PR and pushes; reviewer/merger verify on GitHub per its READY discipline).
acceptanceCriteria.surface: The pull request on GitHub (sjawhar/legion-smoke) — its merged state and its file list showing only README.md changed.

ciSurfaces.note: exits 1 iff a .fail-me file exists at repo root; do NOT add .fail-me. This is the deliberately-breakable required check for the negative control.

implementationSteps: cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE"; on the issue working copy, append the single marker line to README.md (native edit, absolute path).
Verify locally: jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" diff --from main@origin --to @ README.md shows exactly one added line and no other file changed.
Describe the implementation commit, then bookmark set legion/S390753994-1 and jj git push --bookmark legion/S390753994-1.
legion gh -- pr create against main with a body in the READY format; the body MUST contain the line 'Dispatch: S390753994-1'.
Record the E2E (implementer) proof: pre-merge read of README.md on the branch showing the marker line, plus the negative control below, at the head SHA.
integrationEvidence: After a human merges, the implementer reads README.md on merged main (legion gh -- api repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/contents/README.md) and confirms the marker line is present; record on the PR Production line, a PR comment with the Legion footer, and a dispatch_message on the issue.
negativeControl: Deliberately broken input for the proof: temporarily stage a second unrelated file change (or a README edit that is not the exact marker line) and observe the acceptance check reject it (diff shows more than the one marker line / wrong content). Do NOT push it. Alternatively, the fail-on-demand gate is the breakable required check: adding a .fail-me file would turn the gate red — used only to demonstrate the gate can fail; never committed.
ordering: implement (append + push + PR + implementer E2E) -> test (independent re-verify + tester E2E) -> review (thermo pair + threads) -> merge (human merges) -> implementer production check (read README.md on merged main).

implement: legion-worker: drives the implementer's workspace binding, jj commit, bookmark push, PR creation, and E2E proof on the file surface.
review: legion-worker: defines the reviewer's GitHub-fact verification, per-thread disposition, thermonuclear pair at final head, and approval discipline for the docs-only diff.
test: legion-worker: defines the tester's duty to independently re-verify the implementer's proof (file diff + CI green) and record E2E (tester) with a negative control.

reviewEvidence: Reviewer verifies CI, Threads, and E2E facts on GitHub directly.
PR diff is exactly one appended line to README.md; no other file changed.
A review MAY request one additional appended line to the same README.md; appending that second line is in scope for this issue (per spec Requirements/Design).
Thermonuclear pair (deep-review + code-quality) runs once at the final head; ce-simplify-code is not applicable to a docs-only diff.
risks: This is a smoke/proof issue; the only real risk is touching more than one file — keep the diff to README.md alone.
Do not create a new file instead of appending (spec Rejected); do not add .fail-me (would fail the gate).
summary: Append exactly one line 'Stage 3 durable workflow proof for issue S390753994-1.' to README.md at the root of sjawhar/legion-smoke, open a PR against main carrying only that one-line change, and take it through test, review, and merge. This is a single-file, build-safe append; no other file, route, or component changes.

targetFiles.change: Append exactly one new final line reading: Stage 3 durable workflow proof for issue S390753994-1.

testEvidence: Tester re-runs the implementer's file-diff check independently: confirm exactly one added line (the marker) in README.md and no other file touched.
Tester confirms CI green at head: ci/check success and fail-on-demand/gate success (legion gh -- pr checks).
Tester records E2E (tester) with a negative control.
